data.name: Asmarth
data.gender_notes: Asmarth is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Asmarth is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘as’ meaning 'to' and ‘smartha’ meaning 'mind'. This name signifies one who is the lord of the mind, and is often used for boys in Hindu culture. The name Asmarth carries the meaning “Lord of the mind” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Asmarth usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the mind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Asmarth belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the mind.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Asmarth total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
